context: You have just rescued Duke Ulder Ravengard from the Iron Throne and reunited him with his son, Wyll; the hostages taken by the Throne are likewise coming out intact. The Emperors have intervened—Ravengard is “tadpoled” but now under the Emperor’s protection and his mind is largely his own again. The player’s tadpole resonates with Ravengard’s, and although the Absolute’s influence has been silenced the parasite’s aftereffects leave him with a powerful, lingering headache. The Emperors will guide Ravengard back to the player’s camp, where he will wait and be available for further conversation.
